episode_summary: In this episode, Carrie McCormick discusses the current trends in the luxury real estate market, emphasizing the importance of personalized client interactions and accurate market knowledge. She highlights the role of AI as a supportive tool rather than a replacement for agents, and shares strategies for maintaining client relationships and leveraging social media for visibility.
